CPV.note: Describes the SNIAC system and its use; names no identity law.

facts.fact: IMIJ says SNIAC links more than 50 public and private services, with banking foremost.
IMIJ says SNIAC supports the Justice, Consular and National portals and connects public and private services, banks especially.
IMIJ reports more than 30 million data requests recorded on SNIAC and over 50 connected services.

systems.system: SNIAC (Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil)

CPV.note: SNIAC is described as an identification and authentication system; the source does not call it a population register.
